aboutDoctor.title: Get to Know Us
aboutDoctor.description: Dr. KARAALTIN, the father of twin children and husband of a successful wife (Vice Dean of Cerrapasa University Faculty of Medicine), was born in 1972 in Kirkuk, Iraq as a Turkish descendant. His family moved to the United States of America when he was only six months old. Between 1976 and 1988, Dr. Karaaltin completed her primary and secondary education in both West Lafayette, Indiana and Orange County, Los Angeles.

rhinoplasty.description: Smart templates in rhinoplasty are revolutionising the way surgeons approach this delicate procedure. Focusing on durability, predictability and reliability in late results, these templates play an important role in guiding the post-operative healing process.

twirlBra.description: Breast reduction and lift surgeries are widely in demand to improve breast aesthetics, comfort and self-confidence. This is where the Twirl Internal Bra Technique comes in; a breakthrough surgical procedure designed to directly address these issues.

vibrasatPro.description: Vibrasat Pro™ and Liposat Pro Plus represent a new era in body contouring, combining advanced vibration-expansion technology with a specialized peristaltic pump for safer, more precise fat removal and grafting.

kGlide.description: Discover the K-Glide™ Rapid Breast Augmentation—a groundbreaking 30-minute procedure developed by renowned plastic surgeon Professor Dr. Karaaltin.

qualifiedDoctors.title: Qualified Doctors
qualifiedDoctors.description: Our team consists of the best medical professionals representing almost every medical specialty to provide you and your family with the highest level of care.

modernEquipment.title: Modern Equipment
modernEquipment.description: We use the latest equipment and technology to raise the level of our medical solutions and guarantee our customers the best experience.

individualApproach.title: Individual Approach
individualApproach.description: Thanks to the individual approach we apply at the Dr. Karaaltın Clinic, our patients receive a better medical service designed to suit their personal health needs and budget.

patientJourney.heroDescription: A seamless 7-day experience designed for comfort, safety, and world-class care.
patientJourney.introTitle: A Structured, Safe, and Luxurious Patient Experience
patientJourney.introDescription: Your journey has been designed to provide full medical support, comfort, and peace of mind from the moment you land in Istanbul until the moment you return home.

day1.title: Arrival & Consultation
day1.description: You arrive in Istanbul, receive VIP transportation to the clinic for your initial medical consultation and pre-operative tests, then settle comfortably into your 5-star partner hotel.

day2.title: Surgery Day
day2.description: Final consultation, preparation, and your surgical procedure. After surgery, you return to your hotel to rest under medical supervision.

day3.title: Early Recovery & Nurse Visits
day3.description: You rest at your hotel while nurses perform early post-operative checks, provide medication guidance, and support your recovery.

day4.title: Rest & Gentle Activity
day4.description: A restorative day for light movement, hydration, and calm recovery. Optional short walks or quiet time at the hotel.

day5.title: Post-Op Evaluation
day5.description: A full post-operative check with the medical team: wound assessment, progress review, and personalized recovery instructions.

day6.title: Discover Istanbul (Lightly)
day6.description: If cleared by the team, you may enjoy short, gentle outings to experience the beauty of Istanbul while continuing your recovery.

day7.title: Final Checkup & Departure
day7.description: Your final medical evaluation takes place before departure. Afterwards, you are escorted to the airport with lifelong aftercare support.

kglide.title: K-Glide™ Rapid Breast Augmentation
kglide.subtitle: 30-Minute Precision With Natural, Long-Lasting Results
kglide.intro: K-Glide™ Rapid Breast Augmentation, developed by Professor Dr. Mehmet Veli Karaaltin, is a groundbreaking technique engineered for speed, comfort, and unparalleled safety. Using custom-designed vibration-assisted dissection instruments, the procedure preserves nerves, vessels, and breast architecture—creating a perfectly formed implant pocket with minimal trauma and remarkably fast recovery.
kglide.overview1Desc: Motor-assisted gliding instruments separate tissue planes gently, without cautery or blunt-force trauma—meaning less pain, less bleeding, and a pristine anatomical pocket.
kglide.overview2Desc: Efficient anatomical pathways allow the full augmentation to be completed in as little as 30 minutes, minimizing anesthesia exposure while maximizing precision.
kglide.overview3Desc: By preserving tissue integrity and reducing intraoperative bleeding, K-Glide™ eliminates the need for postoperative drains entirely.
kglide.overview4Desc: Sensory nerves and vascular networks are protected through gentle vibration-guided expansion.
kglide.overview5Desc: Most patients return to light activity within 24–48 hours with little to no discomfort.
kglide.overview6Desc: The implant rests in a clean, anatomically precise pocket—supporting a soft, balanced, and stable breast contour.
kglide.featured: K-Glide™ represents the evolution of breast augmentation: a safe, fast, and tissue-preserving technique built on years of surgical innovation. The system enhances patient comfort while elevating the standard for natural aesthetic outcomes.
kglide.tech3: Submuscular, subfascial, or dual-plane implant placement
kglide.precision1: Small hidden incision in the fold
kglide.precision2: Precision pocket creation with minimal trauma
kglide.journey5Desc: Back to daily activities in 24-48 hours
kglide.recovery: Rapid-return method: minimal pain, no drains, and a quick transition back to routine movement within 24–48 hours.

smartbra.title: Smart BRA Bioscaffold
smartbra.subtitle: Regenerative Support for Enhanced Breast Surgery
smartbra.intro: The Smart BRA system utilizes biocompatible scaffolds that integrate with natural tissue, providing enhanced support during healing while promoting natural tissue regeneration.
smartbra.overview1Desc: A biocompatible polycaprolactone (PCL) mesh scaffold designed to support breast tissue during healing and stimulate natural collagen formation.
smartbra.overview2Desc: The scaffold gradually absorbs as your body creates its own internal support structure through natural tissue regeneration.
smartbra.overview3Desc: Provides structural reinforcement that extends the longevity of breast lift and reduction results.
smartbra.overview4Desc: Placed during standard breast procedures without additional incisions or extended recovery time.
smartbra.overview5Desc: Creates lasting internal support as the scaffold is replaced by your own collagen matrix over 9-12 months.
smartbra.featured: The Smart BRA bioscaffold represents a breakthrough in breast surgery support. By harnessing your body's natural regenerative capacity, it provides durable internal support that traditional techniques cannot achieve.
smartbra.outcome1: Enhanced lift durability and shape retention
smartbra.journey2Desc: Custom placement strategy based on your anatomy
smartbra.journey3Desc: Standard procedure with integrated scaffold placement
smartbra.journey5Desc: Full tissue regeneration and lasting results
smartbra.recovery: Recovery follows standard breast surgery protocols. The scaffold integrates naturally without additional discomfort or extended downtime.
smartbra.candidate1Desc: Patients with moderate to severe breast sagging
smartbra.candidate2Desc: Those requiring enhanced support after previous surgery
smartbra.candidate4Desc: Seeking long-term shape and position maintenance

vibrasat.title: Vibrasat Pro™ Technology
vibrasat.subtitle: Precision Fat Removal & Grafting
vibrasat.intro: Vibrasat Pro™ and Liposat Pro Plus represent a new era in body contouring, combining advanced vibration-expansion technology with a specialized peristaltic pump for safer, more precise fat removal and grafting.
vibrasat.overview1Desc: A revolutionary dual-system combining vibration-assisted liposuction with controlled peristaltic fat transfer for optimal results.
vibrasat.overview2Desc: Gentle mechanical vibration creates tissue space without trauma, preserving fat cell viability for grafting.
vibrasat.overview3Desc: The Liposat Pro Plus pump delivers precise, consistent fat injection at controlled pressure and volume.
vibrasat.overview4Desc: Minimal cell damage during harvest and transfer results in significantly improved fat graft survival rates.
vibrasat.overview5Desc: Lower risk of fat necrosis, seromas, and contour irregularities compared to traditional methods.
vibrasat.overview6Desc: Ideal for body contouring, breast augmentation, facial rejuvenation, and gluteal enhancement procedures.
vibrasat.featured: Vibrasat Pro™ technology represents the cutting edge of fat harvesting and transfer. The combination of gentle vibration-expansion and controlled delivery ensures optimal fat cell survival and natural-looking results.
vibrasat.application1: Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) with enhanced safety
vibrasat.recovery: Recovery varies by procedure type. The gentle harvesting technique typically results in less bruising and faster return to normal activities.
vibrasat.candidate1Desc: Seeking precise fat removal and sculpting
vibrasat.candidate3Desc: Requiring fat grafting for any purpose
vibrasat.candidate4Desc: Prioritizing fat survival and natural outcomes

gynecomastia.title: Gynecomastia
gynecomastia.subtitle: Male Chest Contouring for Confidence
gynecomastia.intro: Gynecomastia surgery addresses enlarged male breast tissue, creating a flatter, more masculine chest contour. Dr. Karaaltin combines liposuction with glandular tissue removal for natural, proportionate results.
gynecomastia.card1Text: Gynecomastia is the enlargement of male breast tissue, often caused by hormonal imbalances, genetics, or certain medications. Surgery removes excess tissue to restore a masculine chest contour.
gynecomastia.card2Text: Treatment typically combines liposuction for fatty tissue with direct excision of dense glandular tissue through a small periareolar incision.
gynecomastia.card3Text: Each case is unique—treatment is tailored based on the ratio of fatty to glandular tissue and the degree of skin laxity.
gynecomastia.card4Text: Incisions are strategically placed around the areola edge, healing to become nearly invisible over time.
gynecomastia.card5Text: Once removed, glandular tissue does not return. Results are stable with maintained weight and health.
gynecomastia.featuredText: Gynecomastia surgery restores masculine chest contours and eliminates the self-consciousness many men experience. The procedure is safe, effective, and delivers lasting results.
gynecomastia.liposuctionValue: Removes fatty tissue through small incisions
gynecomastia.excisionValue: Direct removal of dense breast tissue
gynecomastia.tighteningValue: Natural retraction or surgical correction if needed
gynecomastia.recoveryText: Most patients return to work within 1 week. A compression garment is worn for 4-6 weeks to optimize results. Exercise resumes gradually at 4-6 weeks.

hybridAugmentation.title: Hybrid Breast Augmentation
hybridAugmentation.subtitle: Implants + Fat Grafting for Natural Enhancement
hybridAugmentation.intro: Hybrid augmentation combines the predictable volume of implants with the natural refinement of fat grafting, creating results that look and feel completely natural.
hybridAugmentation.card1Text: Combines breast implants with autologous fat transfer to achieve both volume and natural contours—the implant provides projection while fat smooths transitions and adds softness.
hybridAugmentation.card2Text: Implants offer reliable size increase; fat grafting adds natural upper-pole fullness, smooths edges, and creates seamless integration with chest tissue.
hybridAugmentation.card3Text: The fat layer over the implant provides a more natural appearance and softer touch than implants alone.
hybridAugmentation.card4Text: The combination allows precise customization—implant size for desired volume, fat placement for ideal contours.
hybridAugmentation.card5Text: Fat is harvested from areas like abdomen or thighs, providing body sculpting benefits alongside breast enhancement.
hybridAugmentation.featuredText: Hybrid breast augmentation represents the evolution of enhancement surgery—combining the reliability of implants with the natural refinement only your own tissue can provide.
hybridAugmentation.detailsSubtitle: Combined implant and fat transfer approach
hybridAugmentation.implantValue: Selected for optimal projection and size
hybridAugmentation.harvestValue: Collected from donor areas via liposuction
hybridAugmentation.journey1Desc: Discuss goals and evaluate donor sites
hybridAugmentation.recoveryText: Recovery combines elements of both procedures. Most return to work in 1-2 weeks. Final results emerge as fat integrates over 3-6 months.

implantRemoval.title: Implant Removal
implantRemoval.subtitle: Safe Explantation & Breast Restoration
implantRemoval.intro: Implant removal (explantation) addresses concerns about existing breast implants, whether due to complications, personal preference, or desire for a more natural appearance. Dr. Karaaltin offers comprehensive solutions including removal with or without lift.
implantRemoval.card1Text: Common reasons include capsular contracture, implant rupture, size/shape dissatisfaction, lifestyle changes, or desire to return to natural appearance.
implantRemoval.card2Text: Total capsulectomy removes the scar tissue capsule completely; partial capsulectomy may be appropriate for certain cases.
implantRemoval.card3Text: For specific concerns, en bloc technique removes implant and capsule as one intact unit without opening the capsule.
implantRemoval.card4Text: Many patients benefit from mastopexy (breast lift) at the time of removal to address tissue changes and restore shape.
implantRemoval.card5Text: Post-removal, breasts may return to near-original state, though tissue changes depend on implant size and duration.
implantRemoval.featuredText: Implant removal is a deeply personal decision. Dr. Karaaltin provides thorough consultation to understand your goals and create a plan for optimal outcomes—whether that means simple removal, lift, or fat transfer for volume restoration.
implantRemoval.capsuleValue: Total or partial capsulectomy as indicated
implantRemoval.liftValue: Mastopexy to restore shape and position
implantRemoval.enhancementValue: Fat transfer available for natural restoration
implantRemoval.journey1Desc: Discuss concerns and evaluate current state
implantRemoval.journey4Desc: Lift and/or fat transfer if desired
implantRemoval.recoveryText: Recovery is typically faster than original augmentation. Most return to work in 1 week. Results continue to improve as tissues settle over 3-6 months.
implantRemoval.candidate2Desc: Unhappy with size, shape, or feel
implantRemoval.candidate3Desc: Wanting to return to natural appearance

twirlBra.title: Twirl Internal Bra Technique™
twirlBra.subtitle: Lasting Lift, Natural Support — Without Implants
twirlBra.intro: The Twirl Internal Bra Technique™, innovated by Professor Dr. Karaaltin, is a revolutionary approach to breast lifting and reshaping. Using the patient's own tissue to create an internal support system, this technique offers lasting elevation and natural projection—without the need for implants or mesh.
twirlBra.card1Text: Uses autologous tissue to create a 'biological bra' from within, providing lift and support without foreign materials.
twirlBra.card2Text: The internal support structure maintains breast shape and position for years.
twirlBra.card3Text: Results in breasts that look and feel completely natural.
twirlBra.card4Text: Strategic incision placement ensures scars are well-hidden.
twirlBra.card5Text: Perfect for patients seeking alternatives to implant-based solutions.

twirl.title: Twirl Internal Bra™
twirl.subtitle: Lasting Lift, Natural Support — Without Implants
twirl.intro: The Twirl Internal Bra Technique™, innovated by Professor Dr. Karaaltin, is a revolutionary approach to breast lifting and reshaping. Using the patient's own tissue to create an internal support system, this technique offers lasting elevation and natural projection—without the need for implants or mesh.
twirl.featured: The Twirl Internal Bra™ represents a breakthrough in breast lifting surgery. By using the patient's own tissue as a natural internal support system, this technique provides durable elevation and reshaping without implants or foreign materials.
twirl.overview1Desc: Uses autologous tissue to create a 'biological bra' from within, providing lift and support without foreign materials.
twirl.overview2Desc: The internal support structure maintains breast shape and position for years, offering durability that traditional lifts cannot match.
twirl.overview3Desc: Results in breasts that look and feel completely natural, with soft contours and natural motion.
twirl.overview4Desc: Strategic incision placement ensures scars are well-hidden within the natural breast contours.
twirl.overview5Desc: Perfect for patients seeking alternatives to implant-based solutions or those requiring revision surgery.
twirl.tech1: Autologous tissue manipulation to create internal support structure
twirl.tech2: No foreign materials, mesh, or implants required
twirl.tech3: Preserves natural breast tissue and sensation
twirl.journey1Desc: Comprehensive assessment and goal setting with personalized planning
twirl.journey2Desc: Precise marking and tissue analysis for optimal support structure
twirl.journey3Desc: Creation of internal support using patient's own tissue
twirl.journey4Desc: Final contouring and closure with minimal scarring
twirl.journey5Desc: Structured healing protocol with compression garment
twirl.recovery: Most patients return to light activities within 1-2 weeks. The internal support structure settles and strengthens over 3-6 months, providing lasting results.
twirl.candidate1Desc: Patients wanting breast elevation without implants
twirl.candidate2Desc: Those preferring no foreign materials in their body
twirl.candidate3Desc: Patients seeking solutions after previous surgeries

breastLift.title: Breast Lift (Mastopexy)
breastLift.subtitle: Restore Youthful Position & Shape
breastLift.intro: Breast lift surgery addresses sagging and loss of shape by repositioning the breast tissue and nipple to a more youthful position.
breastLift.card1Text: Aging, pregnancy, breastfeeding, and weight changes affect shape and support.
breastLift.card2Text: Benelli, Vertical, or Wise Pattern depending on severity of ptosis.
breastLift.card3Text: Repositions and reshapes the areola as needed.
breastLift.card4Text: Can combine with implants or fat grafting.
breastLift.card5Text: Improves contour without altering overall breast size (unless combined).
breastLift.featuredText: The procedure offers a transformative improvement in shape and positioning—with or without added volume.
breastLift.detailsSubtitle: Mastopexy techniques for youthful breast restoration
breastLift.combinationValue: Can be combined with augmentation or reduction
breastLift.recoveryText: 7–10 days to daily activities; full activity at 4–6 weeks; swelling resolves in 4–6 weeks.

breastReduction.title: Breast Reduction
breastReduction.subtitle: Relief & Proportion Through Precision
breastReduction.intro: Breast reduction surgery removes excess breast tissue to achieve a size that is more proportionate to your body, relieving physical discomfort and improving quality of life.
breastReduction.card1Text: Relieves back, neck, and shoulder pain; improves posture; eliminates bra-strap grooves.
breastReduction.card2Text: Reduces volume, reshapes the breast, and lifts the nipple-areolar complex.
breastReduction.card3Text: Anchor, vertical, or peri-areolar—selected based on degree of ptosis.
breastReduction.card4Text: Breast mound is reshaped for optimal symmetry and proportions.
breastReduction.card5Text: Multimodal pain control minimizes narcotic use.
breastReduction.featuredText: Patients consistently report this as one of the most satisfying procedures due to improvements in comfort, confidence, and overall lifestyle.
breastReduction.detailsSubtitle: Key aspects of the breast reduction procedure
breastReduction.recoveryText: Return to work in 1–2 weeks; bras worn 4–6 weeks; swelling improves significantly in 2 weeks.

breastAugmentationImplants.title: Breast Augmentation With Implants
breastAugmentationImplants.subtitle: Sculpted Volume. Precision Planning. Long-Lasting Results.
breastAugmentationImplants.intro: Breast augmentation with implants remains the gold standard for achieving significant volume enhancement and upper-pole fullness. Dr. Karaaltin combines advanced planning, anatomical mapping, and tailored implant selection to deliver balanced, natural-looking results that complement every patient's physique and aesthetic goals.
breastAugmentationImplants.card1Text: Silicone or saline; round or anatomical; smooth or textured; selected for your anatomy and goals.
breastAugmentationImplants.card2Text: Submuscular, subfascial, subglandular, or dual-plane based on soft-tissue support and desired contour.
breastAugmentationImplants.card3Text: IMF, periareolar, or transaxillary—chosen for concealment and safety.
breastAugmentationImplants.card4Text: Ideal after pregnancy, weight loss, or congenital asymmetry.
breastAugmentationImplants.card5Text: Implant sizes measured in cc for precise volumetric control.
breastAugmentationImplants.featuredText: This procedure offers predictable size enhancement, enhanced cleavage, and upper-pole definition with long-lasting implant stability.
breastAugmentationImplants.detailsSubtitle: Essential aspects of breast augmentation with implants
breastAugmentationImplants.correctionsValue: Can correct asymmetry, tuberous breast, or post-cancer reconstruction
breastAugmentationImplants.recoveryText: 10–14 days to return to work; 6–8 weeks activity restrictions; scar care begins at 2–3 weeks.

smartTemplate.title: Smart Template Rhinoplasty
smartTemplate.subtitle: Where Innovation Meets Regeneration
smartTemplate.intro1: Smart Template Rhinoplasty, pioneered by Professor Dr. Karaaltin, represents a breakthrough in nasal surgery. These bioengineered, fully absorbable scaffolds guide the healing process after rhinoplasty, stabilizing the nasal framework and enhancing symmetry.
smartTemplate.intro2: Each template is custom-designed to match the patient's anatomy, supporting long-term regeneration of cartilage, bone, and soft tissue.
smartTemplate.card1Text: Biodegradable scaffolds act as an internal mold during healing, ensuring predictable shape retention and stable outcomes.
smartTemplate.card2Text: The material dissolves gradually as the body replaces it with natural, integrated tissue—supporting angiogenesis, cellular repair, and scarless remodeling.
smartTemplate.card3Text: Templates function like a biological GPS, preventing postoperative drift, collapse, or warping of cartilage.
smartTemplate.card4Text: Presented by Dr. Karaaltin at the European Society of Rhinoplasty, this technique gained international recognition for its scientific foundation and clinical reliability.
smartTemplate.card5Text: Custom-shaped bioscaffolds created with millimetric accuracy. Enhance nasal structure without rigid grafts and integrate safely without inflammatory response.
smartTemplate.featuredText: By aligning regenerative biology with precision engineering, Smart Template Rhinoplasty represents the next evolution of nasal surgery. It offers unmatched stability, predictable outcomes, and natural definition—with reduced risk of postoperative deformities.
smartTemplate.outcomes2: Synergy with preservation, ultrasonic, or structural techniques
smartTemplate.journey2Desc: Detailed analysis for custom template design
smartTemplate.recoveryText: Templates dissolve naturally over time as vascularized tissue replaces them, reducing the risk of asymmetry or collapse during healing.
smartTemplate.scarText: Follows the scar expectations of the selected rhinoplasty technique (open or closed).
smartTemplate.galleryCta: Explore the stability and definition of Smart Template–supported results

rhinoplasty.title: Rhinoplasty
rhinoplasty.subtitle: Form, Function & Natural Harmony
rhinoplasty.intro: Professor Dr. Karaaltin's approach to rhinoplasty balances aesthetic refinement with functional optimization, creating results that are natural, harmonious, and long-lasting.
rhinoplasty.card1Text: Minimal disruption to existing nasal structures, maintaining natural support and function.
rhinoplasty.card2Text: Piezoelectric tools for exact bone reshaping without trauma to surrounding soft tissue.
rhinoplasty.card3Text: Airway optimization is integral to every aesthetic rhinoplasty procedure.
rhinoplasty.card4Text: Techniques adapted to preserve ethnic identity while achieving desired refinements.
rhinoplasty.card5Text: Digital planning ensures predictable outcomes aligned with facial proportions.
rhinoplasty.card6Text: When needed, cartilage grafts provide long-term stability and definition.
rhinoplasty.card7Text: Complex revision cases managed with microsurgical precision.
rhinoplasty.card8Text: Advanced techniques minimize swelling and accelerate healing.
rhinoplasty.card9Text: Outcomes that harmonize with your unique facial features.
rhinoplasty.featuredText: Dr. Karaaltin's rhinoplasty philosophy combines preservation techniques with advanced technology, ensuring each patient receives a customized approach that respects their anatomy while achieving their aesthetic goals.
rhinoplasty.approach1: Preservation rhinoplasty: maintaining natural dorsal lines
rhinoplasty.excellence1: Functional and aesthetic goals addressed simultaneously
rhinoplasty.excellence2: Personalized approach for each patient's unique anatomy
rhinoplasty.journey1Desc: Comprehensive evaluation of nasal structure and goals
rhinoplasty.recoveryText: Most patients return to work within 7-10 days. Swelling progressively resolves over 3-6 months, with final results visible at 12 months.
rhinoplasty.candidate1Desc: Seeking refinement of nasal shape or size
rhinoplasty.scarClosedText: All incisions inside the nose—no visible external scars.
rhinoplasty.scarOpenText: Small columellar incision that heals nearly invisibly.

endochorFaceLift.title: The Endochor® Face Lift
endochorFaceLift.subtitle: Minimally Invasive. Maximally Effective.
endochorFaceLift.intro1: The Endochor® Face Lift is a cutting-edge endoscopic lifting system designed by Professor Dr. Karaaltin. It blends minimally invasive access with custom-engineered biodegradable implants that reposition deep facial structures without visible scars.
endochorFaceLift.intro2: Ideal for rejuvenating the brow, midface, and neck, this system reduces downtime while delivering stable, natural-looking elevation.
endochorFaceLift.card1Text: Biodegradable PCL implants engineered for optimal vectors, soft-tissue integration, and long-term support—without permanent foreign material.
endochorFaceLift.card2Text: Enhances brow, temporal, and upper-face zones using discreet scalp incisions and vertical/oblique lift vectors—completely scarless.
endochorFaceLift.card3Text: Elevates malar and nasolabial structures, restoring contour and midface volume without the need for fillers or extensive dissection.
endochorFaceLift.card4Text: A versatile bioanchor supporting neck rejuvenation, lower face lift, and temporal & midface anchoring. Offers secure, customizable lifting planes.
endochorFaceLift.card5Text: Endoscopic access + pre-shaped implants shorten operative duration, minimize trauma, and accelerate recovery.
endochorFaceLift.featuredText: The Endochor® system is backed by decades of anatomical research and bioengineering excellence. Each implant is CE-certified and clinically validated, making this one of the safest and most advanced scarless lifting solutions available.
endochorFaceLift.journey1Desc: Comprehensive assessment of facial anatomy and rejuvenation goals
endochorFaceLift.journey2Desc: Precise identification of lift vectors and implant placement
endochorFaceLift.journey3Desc: Custom Endochor® implant configuration for optimal results
endochorFaceLift.journey4Desc: Endoscopic elevation of brow, midface, and/or neck
endochorFaceLift.journey5Desc: Minimal downtime protocol with structured follow-ups
endochorFaceLift.recoveryText: Minimal swelling, rapid return to daily activity, and no visible facial scars. Implant integration enhances long-term support.
endochorFaceLift.scarText: No visible facial scars. All incisions are hidden within the scalp or natural creases.
endochorFaceLift.galleryCta: Explore transformative EndoChor® Face Lift results from Professor Dr. Karaaltin's patients.

kEndoscopic.title: K Endoscopic Deep Plane Face Lift
kEndoscopic.subtitle: The Future of Facial Rejuvenation
kEndoscopic.intro1: The K Endoscopic Deep Plane Face Lift combines the benefits of deep plane surgery with minimally invasive endoscopic access, delivering dramatic yet natural results.
kEndoscopic.intro2: This revolutionary technique offers comprehensive facial rejuvenation with minimal scarring and faster recovery.
kEndoscopic.card1Text: The K Endoscopic Deep Plane Face Lift represents a paradigm shift in facial rejuvenation. By combining endoscopic precision with deep plane techniques, it achieves comprehensive lifting without the extensive incisions of traditional surgery.
kEndoscopic.card2Text: Custom-designed instruments allow precise manipulation of deep facial structures through minimal access points, enabling complete ligament release and tissue repositioning.
kEndoscopic.card3Text: The technique creates a unified facial flap that includes:
kEndoscopic.card4Text: High-definition endoscopic visualization provides magnified views of delicate structures, ensuring safe dissection around nerves and vessels while maximizing lifting effect.

advancedSafeBBL.title: Advanced Safe BBL™
advancedSafeBBL.subtitle: A New Era of Safe, Scientific Gluteal Augmentation
advancedSafeBBL.intro: The Advanced Safe BBL™ developed by Professor Dr. Mehmet Veli Karaaltin represents the safest, most scientifically validated, and technologically advanced version of the modern Brazilian Butt Lift. Based on more than 543 audited patients, 20 cadaveric dissections, and real-time monitoring systems, this protocol drastically reduces the risks of fat embolism and serious complications while achieving natural projection, stable results, and controlled recovery.
advancedSafeBBL.card1Title: What Is the Advanced Safe BBL™
advancedSafeBBL.card1Text: The Advanced Safe BBL™ is a comprehensive fat gluteoplasty system designed to maximize safety and precision. It uses real-time ultrasound monitoring, vascular Doppler, controlled fat injection, and stem-cell-enriched technology for consistent and long-lasting results.
advancedSafeBBL.card2Text: Injection is performed exclusively above the muscle, verified in real-time using wireless Clarius AI™ technology. This eliminates the risk of deep injections near major gluteal vessels and completely avoids "blind" technique.
advancedSafeBBL.card3Text: Before and during surgery, all relevant vascular perforators are mapped to avoid critical vessels. This guides safe trajectories for fat, reducing trauma risk and improving graft survival.
advancedSafeBBL.card4Text: The dual Vibrosat Pro™ + Liposat Pump™ system allows uniform mechanical tissue expansion and controlled injection in ml/min.
advancedSafeBBL.card5Text: Using Stempia™ technology, the graft combines macro and micro fat with fat-derived stem cells, increasing vascularity, improving graft survival, and generating a smoother, more natural and stable result.
advancedSafeBBL.card6Text: In 543 patients, the use of the complete protocol reduced major complications by more than 90%:
advancedSafeBBL.featuredTitle: Advanced Safe BBL™ With Dr. Karaaltin
advancedSafeBBL.featuredText: The Advanced Safe BBL™ is not just an aesthetic procedure: it is a surgical system based on science, advanced anatomy, and continuous monitoring technology. Designed by Prof. Dr. Karaaltin—a pioneer in reconstructive and microsurgical surgery—this method redefines the modern standard of safe gluteal augmentation, achieving smooth curves, natural proportions, and results that respect vascular integrity.
advancedSafeBBL.pillar2: Controlled injection: precise flow, no pressure spikes.
advancedSafeBBL.pillar4: Stem cell-enriched fat: better integration and projection.
advancedSafeBBL.spongeText: In a comparative study with five leading technologies, Vibrosat Pro™ + Liposat Pump™ produced the most uniform dispersion, without dead zones or tissue damage. This evidence supports the biomechanical superiority of the system.
advancedSafeBBL.revisionsText: For cases of fibrosis or previous BBL failures, the macro/micro fat cell technique invented by Dr. Karaaltin allows correction of contour deformities in one or two sessions, using precise layers of enriched grafting.
advancedSafeBBL.journey1Desc: 3D analysis, anatomical evaluation, and proportion definition.
advancedSafeBBL.journey3Desc: Extraction, purification, enrichment, and ultrasound-guided reinjection.
advancedSafeBBL.journey5Desc: Critical reviews during the first 10 days for maximum safety.
advancedSafeBBL.recoveryText: Specialized compression garment, early mobilization, and structured follow-up protocol to ensure optimal fat survival and patient safety.

ribCageMolding.title: Rib Cage Molding

ribCageMolding.intro: Rib cage molding is an advanced body contouring technique that creates a more defined waistline through strategic sculpting of the lower rib area.

tummyTuck.title: Tummy Tuck (Abdominoplasty)
tummyTuck.subtitle: A Toned, Rejuvenated Abdomen — Redefined by Precision
tummyTuck.intro1: A tummy tuck, or abdominoplasty, is one of the most transformative body contouring procedures available. Whether due to pregnancy, weight changes, or natural aging, excess skin and weakened abdominal muscles can blur the body's natural definition.
tummyTuck.intro2: Professor Dr. Mehmet Veli Karaaltin restores a firm, sculpted midsection through advanced surgical planning, anatomical expertise, and techniques designed for long-lasting, natural-looking results.
tummyTuck.card1Text: A tummy tuck removes excess abdominal skin and fat while tightening separated or weakened muscles. Unlike liposuction alone, it corrects both skin laxity and muscle diastasis (rectus separation), restoring a firm, youthful abdominal contour.
tummyTuck.card2Item1: Subcutaneous "pinchable" fat is removed or reshaped.
tummyTuck.card2Item2: Visceral fat cannot be surgically removed and may influence candidacy.
tummyTuck.card2Item3: The linea alba, often stretched after pregnancy or weight gain, is repaired to correct abdominal wall separation.
tummyTuck.card3Text: Each abdominoplasty is tailored to patient anatomy and goals, with options such as:
tummyTuck.card3Conclusion: These variations allow the surgeon to refine both function and aesthetics while minimizing trauma and maximizing results.
tummyTuck.card4Text: This procedure restores core stability, reduces skin laxity, improves silhouette definition, and enhances confidence. For many individuals, it is the most effective solution when exercise and diet cannot address structural abdominal changes.
tummyTuck.featuredText1: Refined abdominal contouring requires mastery of anatomy and modern surgical innovation. With decades of experience in reconstructive and aesthetic surgery, Professor Dr. Karaaltin combines precision muscle repair, advanced lipocontouring, and scar-optimized incision design to produce results that look natural from every angle.
tummyTuck.featuredText2: His approach prioritizes patient safety, proportional balance, and long-term integrity of the abdominal wall.
tummyTuck.muscleRepairText: Many patients experience abdominal muscle separation after pregnancy or weight fluctuation. During surgery, Dr. Karaaltin reinforces the abdominal wall using permanent or long-acting absorbable sutures, improving stability and posture.
tummyTuck.skinFatText: Excess skin is removed and the remaining tissue is redraped for a smooth, natural finish. Liposuction may be added to contour the flanks and waistline, enhancing hourglass definition.
tummyTuck.umbilicalText: Depending on the technique, the belly button may be repositioned using scar-optimized methods to achieve a natural aesthetic with minimal visibility.
tummyTuck.journey1Desc: Comprehensive assessment of abdominal anatomy, lifestyle factors, medical history, and desired silhouette.
tummyTuck.journey2Desc: Secure photo submission for remote evaluation when applicable.
tummyTuck.journey3Desc: Precise incision mapping, muscle evaluation, fat distribution analysis, and determination of combined techniques.
tummyTuck.journey4Desc: Performed under general (or in select cases, epidural) anesthesia. Duration varies from 2–5 hours depending on complexity.
tummyTuck.journey5Desc: Includes garment fitting, drain management, wound care, mobility guidance, and structured follow-up visits.
tummyTuck.recoveryIntro: Recovery duration depends on anatomy and technique.
tummyTuck.recoveryItem1: Hospital stay: 1–2 days for full abdominoplasty
tummyTuck.recoveryItem3: Mobility: Patients walk slightly bent for 5–7 days
tummyTuck.recoveryItem5: Heavy lifting: Avoid for at least 6 weeks
tummyTuck.recoveryConclusion: A compression garment and lymphatic drainage massage support healing and swelling reduction.
tummyTuck.candidate1Desc: BMI preferably below 30 or stable weight
tummyTuck.candidate2Desc: Skin laxity or muscle separation unresponsive to exercise
tummyTuck.candidate3Desc: Non-smoker or committed to pausing smoking pre- and post-op
tummyTuck.candidate4Desc: Realistic expectations regarding scars and recovery
tummyTuck.miniScarText: Short, low incision similar to a C-section, ideal for lower abdominal laxity.
tummyTuck.fullScarText: Hip-to-hip incision hidden along the bikini line, plus a small hidden umbilical scar.
tummyTuck.fleurScarText: Horizontal + vertical scar pattern for extreme excess skin removal, common after massive weight loss.
tummyTuck.resultsText: See how abdominal contouring transforms confidence and silhouette.

ribCageMolding.title: Rib Cage Molding with Piezo Technology
ribCageMolding.subtitle: Precision Waist Contouring — Without Rib Removal
ribCageMolding.intro1: Rib Cage Molding with Piezo Technology is an advanced technique created by Prof. Dr. Karaaltin that redefines waist contouring without resorting to traditional rib resection. Through 0.5 cm microincisions and piezoelectric remodeling of the floating ribs, the procedure allows visible reduction of thoracic width with safety, elegance, and minimal recovery.
ribCageMolding.intro2: This innovation combines controlled vibration technology, anatomical approach, and functional preservation to achieve a slimmer silhouette without compromising bone structure.
ribCageMolding.card1Text: A minimally invasive procedure that gently reshapes the floating ribs using piezoelectric technology. It does not involve rib extraction, does not alter deep anatomy, and maintains complete structural safety.
ribCageMolding.card2Text: Piezoelectric energy allows sculpting the costal edge with precision micro-movements, avoiding heat, trauma, or aggressive vibrations.
ribCageMolding.card3Text: The technique uses a single 0.5 cm microincision — virtually invisible once healed. Through this minimal window, the piezoelectric instrument is introduced to reshape the ribs with maximum precision and minimal aggression.
ribCageMolding.card4Text: Patients who desire a narrower waist without major surgery, individuals with a wide rib cage that affects proportions, and patients seeking natural results without visible scars or extensive recovery time.
ribCageMolding.card5Text: Recognized for his mastery of advanced anatomical techniques and minimally invasive procedures, Dr. Karaaltin combines scientific innovation, surgical safety, and premium aesthetics. His approach is backed by research, advanced experimentation, and consistent results.
ribCageMolding.featuredTitle: Rib Cage Molding With Dr. Karaaltin
ribCageMolding.featuredText: Rib Cage Molding with Piezo Technology is a modern and safe alternative to rib resection. Through controlled ultrasonic vibration, Dr. Karaaltin reshapes the costal edge to refine the silhouette, reduce lateral width, and harmonize proportions. The technique maintains thoracic stability and avoids risks associated with more invasive bone surgeries.
ribCageMolding.journey1Desc: Anatomical analysis, proportion study, and expectations.
ribCageMolding.journey2Desc: Rib cage evaluation, projection, and symmetry assessment.
ribCageMolding.journey4Desc: Minimal bandaging and quick return to activities.
ribCageMolding.recoveryItem4: Avoid direct pressure the first week
ribCageMolding.recoveryText: The accelerated recovery allows most patients to return to daily routines within days, with progressive results becoming visible over 4–8 weeks as inflammation resolves.
ribCageMolding.candidate1Desc: Want a slimmer waist without rib surgery
ribCageMolding.candidate2Desc: Wide rib cage affecting body proportions

breastAugmentationFatGrafting.title: Breast Augmentation with Fat Grafting
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.subtitle: Natural Volume. Soft Contour. Implant-Free Enhancement.
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.intro: Breast augmentation with fat grafting—also known as structural autologous augmentation—is a natural, implant-free method that enhances volume and reshapes the breast using the patient's own purified fat. Under Dr. Karaaltin's advanced micro-droplet injection protocol, fat is harvested, refined, and layered to create soft, symmetrical, and long-lasting breast enhancement while simultaneously contouring donor areas.
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.card1Text: Liposuction harvests fat → purified → injected in micro-droplets for natural shaping and vascular integration.
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.card2Text: Ideal for patients seeking subtle to moderate enhancement (≈1 cup size per session).
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.card3Text: Donor sites such as abdomen, thighs, flanks, or arms are sculpted during fat harvest.
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.card4Text: Fat integrates with breast tissue, creating completely natural texture.
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.card5Text: Multi-layered micro-droplet placement maximizes survival and symmetry.
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.featuredText: This technique is ideal for patients wanting natural enhancement without foreign materials and offers highly customizable shaping, symmetry correction, and soft-tissue improvement.
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.detailsSubtitle: Advanced fat grafting technology for natural, lasting breast enhancement
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.enhancementValue: Optional SVF (stem cell–enriched grafting) for enhanced fat survival
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.journey3Desc: Gentle fat extraction from donor areas
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.journey4Desc: Processing and preparation of fat cells
breastAugmentationFatGrafting.recoveryText: 4–6 weeks swelling; donor site soreness; no compression on breasts; final contour at 3–4 months.

nippleAreola.subtitle: Precision Refinement for Balanced Aesthetics

nippleAreola.card2Desc: Improves proportion, symmetry, and comfort in clothing.
nippleAreola.card3Desc: Fine incisions placed strategically for minimal visibility and predictable contouring.
nippleAreola.card4Desc: Integrates seamlessly with lifts, reductions, augmentations, or chest contouring.

invertedNipple.card1Desc: Inversion occurs when tethered ducts or structural constraints prevent normal outward projection.
invertedNipple.card2Desc: For patients seeking natural projection, symmetry improvement, and confidence restoration.
invertedNipple.card3Desc: Includes anatomical photography, assessment, technique selection, and risk-benefit review.
invertedNipple.card4Desc: Micro-incision release, internal support sutures, and scar-minimizing closure.
invertedNipple.card5Desc: Technique aims to preserve nerve pathways and, when feasible, breastfeeding potential.
invertedNipple.card6Desc: 30–60 minutes; supportive dressing for 5–7 days; return to daily routine quickly.

invertedNipple.step2: Create micro-incision and release tethering structures.
invertedNipple.step3: Place internal support sutures for projection stability.
invertedNipple.step4: Apply a protective dressing for 5–7 days.
invertedNipple.step5: Schedule follow-up to evaluate symmetry and healing.

kFaceLift.title: K Face Lift
kFaceLift.subtitle: Revolutionary Dual-Vector Facial Rejuvenation
kFaceLift.intro: The K Face Lift, developed by Professor Dr. Karaaltin, represents a revolutionary approach to facial rejuvenation that combines multiple advanced techniques for comprehensive results.
kFaceLift.card1Title: What Makes the K Face Lift Revolutionary
kFaceLift.card1Text: A dynamic lift designed to preserve facial expression while delivering powerful rejuvenation. Combines High SMAS and Deep Plane concepts for enhanced lifting, optimized safety, and minimal scarring.
kFaceLift.card2Text: A proprietary system of surgical zones defining frontal nerve protection pathways, modiolus vascular arcade preservation, and deep plane & SMAS elevation vectors.
kFaceLift.card2Conclusion: These mappings reduce downtime, improve safety, and maximize aesthetic outcome.
kFaceLift.card3Text: Two independent SMAS flaps deliver true 3D rejuvenation:
kFaceLift.card3Vector1: Rotates and elevates midface, malar region & brow
kFaceLift.card3Vector2: Advances toward the mastoid to sharpen jawline & neck
kFaceLift.card3Conclusion: Supported by biodegradable PCL mesh for lasting structural integrity.
kFaceLift.card4Text: Performed simultaneously, addressing platysma bands, digastric muscle issues, submandibular gland prominence, and cervico-mental angle definition.
kFaceLift.card5Text: A CE-certified PCL mesh implant reinforces structural support, integrates naturally over 9–12 months, and dissolves without residue. Manufactured by Bloocell, founded by Dr. Karaaltin.
kFaceLift.featuredTitle: K Face Lift With Dr. Karaaltin
kFaceLift.featuredText: The K Face Lift represents a new standard in modern facial surgery—uniting scientific precision, artistic detail, and a patient-specific approach. Professor Dr. Karaaltin's unmatched anatomical expertise allows him to deliver deeply natural, expressive, and durable results without distortion or rigidity.
kFaceLift.detailsSubtitle: Advanced multi-layer facial rejuvenation with mesh reinforcement
kFaceLift.detail1Desc: Respecting nerve and vascular anatomy for safe, comprehensive lifting.
kFaceLift.detail2Desc: Flap engineering for natural vectors and balanced facial proportions.
kFaceLift.detail3Desc: Biodegradable PCL support for lasting structural integrity.
kFaceLift.detail4Desc: Simultaneous upper, mid, and lower face rejuvenation.
kFaceLift.detail5Desc: Strategic incision placement for minimal visibility.
kFaceLift.journey1Desc: Comprehensive facial analysis and aesthetic goals discussion.
kFaceLift.journey2Desc: Precise identification of lifting vectors and nerve pathways.
kFaceLift.journey3Desc: Customized approach tailored to individual anatomy.
kFaceLift.journey4Desc: Dynamic multi-layer lifting with rotation-advancement technique.
kFaceLift.journey6Desc: Structured recovery protocol and follow-up visits.
kFaceLift.recoveryText: Most patients experience rapid functional recovery due to landmark-guided dissection. Swelling subsides progressively, with results refining over several months as the mesh supports collagen regeneration.
kFaceLift.candidate1Desc: Seeking full face and neck rejuvenation
kFaceLift.scarText: Incisions are strategically placed within the hairline and natural creases around the ear, becoming virtually invisible as they heal. The K Face Lift technique prioritizes scar optimization as part of its comprehensive approach.

smartTemplate.title: Smart Template Rhinoplasty
smartTemplate.subtitle: Precision Healing Through Bioengineered Scaffolds
smartTemplate.intro1: Smart Template Rhinoplasty represents a paradigm shift in nasal surgery, combining traditional surgical expertise with cutting-edge bioengineered scaffolds that guide postoperative healing.
smartTemplate.intro2: Developed by Professor Dr. Karaaltin in collaboration with Bloocell®, this technique ensures predictable, stable outcomes by providing an internal 'mold' during the critical healing phase.
smartTemplate.overview1Desc: Biodegradable scaffolds act as an internal mold during healing, ensuring predictable shape retention and stable outcomes.
smartTemplate.overview2Desc: The material dissolves gradually as the body replaces it with natural, integrated tissue—supporting angiogenesis, cellular repair, and scarless remodeling.
smartTemplate.overview3Desc: Templates function like a biological GPS, preventing postoperative drift, collapse, or warping of cartilage.
smartTemplate.overview4Desc: Presented by Dr. Karaaltin at the European Society of Rhinoplasty, this technique gained international recognition for its scientific foundation and clinical reliability.
smartTemplate.overview5Desc: Custom-shaped bioscaffolds created with millimetric accuracy. Enhance nasal structure without rigid grafts and integrate safely without inflammatory response.
smartTemplate.featured: Smart Template Rhinoplasty bridges the gap between surgical vision and biological reality. The bioengineered scaffolds ensure that your nose heals exactly as planned—with precision, predictability, and natural integration.
smartTemplate.journey1Desc: Comprehensive nasal analysis and goal setting
smartTemplate.journey2Desc: Custom scaffold creation based on 3D mapping
smartTemplate.recovery: Recovery follows standard rhinoplasty protocols. The template provides internal support during healing, reducing the risk of postoperative changes and ensuring predictable results.

face.title: FACE

face.philosophyText1: At Dr. Karaaltın's practice, facial rejuvenation is approached as both an art and a science. Each face tells a unique story, and our goal is to restore and enhance natural beauty while respecting individual anatomical features and aesthetic goals.
face.philosophyText2: Our comprehensive approach considers not just the surface appearance, but the underlying structural changes that occur with aging. This deep understanding allows us to create results that are natural, harmonious, and long-lasting.
face.boneStructureDesc: The skeletal framework provides the foundation for all facial features and defines the overall shape of the face.
face.muscleLayerDesc: Muscles create expression movements and provide support for overlying soft tissues.
face.fatCompartmentsDesc: Strategically distributed fat pads deflate with aging, causing volume loss and shadowing.
face.skinEnvelopeDesc: The skin drapes over underlying structures and loses elasticity with age, requiring precise removal or repositioning.

body.philosophyText2: Our comprehensive approach considers skin quality, underlying musculature, and fat distribution to create results that are balanced, natural, and lasting.
body.skinTissueDesc: Skin elasticity and quality determine the success of body contouring. Understanding tissue characteristics guides treatment planning.
body.fatDistributionDesc: Subcutaneous fat patterns vary by genetics, age, and lifestyle. Strategic removal and repositioning create balanced contours.
body.muscleFoundationDesc: Underlying musculature provides structural support. Addressing muscle separation enhances results in body contouring procedures.
body.bodyProportionsDesc: Natural aesthetic proportions guide surgical planning to create harmonious, balanced results that enhance your silhouette.

breast.philosophyText1: Breast surgery requires a blend of artistic vision and technical expertise. Each procedure is tailored to enhance natural harmony while respecting individual physical characteristics.
breast.philosophyText2: Our philosophy centers on creating results that look and feel natural, with emphasis on proportion, symmetry, and long-term patient satisfaction.

about.globalJourneyText1: Dr. KARAALTIN, the father of twin children and husband of a successful wife (Vice Dean of Cerrahpasa University Faculty of Medicine), was born in 1972 in Kirkuk, Iraq as a Turkish descendant. His family moved to the United States of America when he was only six months old.
about.globalJourneyText2: Between 1976 and 1988, Dr. Karaaltin completed his primary and secondary education in both West Lafayette, Indiana and Orange County, Los Angeles. In 1995, he graduated from Istanbul University Cerrahpasa Faculty of Medicine.
about.globalJourneyText3: He completed his Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery residency in 2001. After his mandatory military service, he became an Assistant Professor in 2003 and an Associate Professor in 2009.
about.educatorLeaderText: Prof. Dr. Karaaltin became a full Professor in 2015 and served as the Head of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery Department at Istanbul University-Cerrahpasa from 2015 to 2021. He has trained numerous surgeons and continues to share his expertise through international lectures and workshops.
about.rhinoplastyText: Pioneer of the Smart Template Rhinoplasty technique, which revolutionizes nasal surgery through precise, predictable outcomes using custom-designed templates for each patient.
about.facialRejuvenationText: Developer of the K-Face Lift and Endoscopic Deep Plane techniques, offering advanced facial rejuvenation with natural, long-lasting results.
about.regenerativeMedicineText: Pioneer in combining regenerative medicine approaches with aesthetic surgery, including advanced fat grafting and stem cell applications.
about.globalRecognitionText1: Professor Dr. Karaaltin is a respected member of prestigious international societies including ASPS (American Society of Plastic Surgeons), ISAPS (International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgery), and EURAPS (European Association of Plastic Surgeons).
about.globalRecognitionText2: He has presented his innovative techniques at over 200 international conferences and has published more than 100 peer-reviewed scientific articles.
about.globalRecognitionText3: His contributions to plastic surgery have earned him recognition as one of the leading experts in aesthetic and reconstructive surgery worldwide.
about.lymphaticSurgeryText: Dr. Karaaltin has pioneered advanced lymphatic surgery techniques for the treatment of lymphedema, offering hope to patients with this challenging condition through microsurgical lymph node transfer and lymphaticovenous anastomosis.
about.advancedSafeBBLText: As a strong advocate for patient safety, Professor Dr. Karaaltin developed the Advanced Safe BBL technique, which significantly reduces the risks associated with traditional Brazilian Butt Lift procedures while achieving excellent aesthetic outcomes.
about.award1: 2017 PRS Best Paper Award — Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery Journal
about.award2: RealSelf Top Doctor Award — Multiple Years
about.award4: Turkish Society of Plastic Surgery Excellence Award

timeline.legacyDescription: Each milestone reflects Dr. Karaaltin's unwavering commitment to advancing the field of plastic and reconstructive surgery. His pioneering work continues to shape modern surgical techniques and improve patient outcomes worldwide.

milestone1.title: World's Third Full Face Transplant & First Quadruple Limb Transplant
milestone1.description: As a core surgical team member at Hacettepe University, Ankara, Dr. Karaaltin participated in two historic procedures: The world's third full face transplantation and the first-ever quadruple limb transplant.

milestone2.title: Innovation in Facial Paralysis Surgery
milestone2.description: Dr. Karaaltin pioneered and popularized the Free Extensor Digitorum Brevis and Extensor Hallucis Brevis Muscle Functional Transfer technique, offering a dynamic, natural solution for smile restoration in facial paralysis patients.

milestone3.title: Life-Saving Treatment of 'The Miracle Man' Adem Kılıç
milestone3.description: Dr. Karaaltin led the complex reconstructive efforts that saved the life of a man with over 75% total body surface area burn injuries, widely regarded as a near-impossible case in modern medicine.

milestone4.title: Awarded Best Scientific Paper in Plastic Surgery
milestone4.description: Dr. Karaaltin's original contribution to reconstructive surgery received the Best Scientific Paper of the Month distinction in an internationally recognized plastic surgery journal.

milestone5.title: Multi-Level Free Vascularized Lymph Node Transfer Popularized
milestone5.description: In a remarkable pediatric case, Dr. Karaaltin introduced and performed bilateral six-level vascularized lymph node transfer for lymphedema in a 14-year-old Romanian patient, setting a precedent in the field.

milestone6.title: Pioneering Conjoined Twin Separation Surgery
milestone6.description: Dr. Karaaltin successfully led the complex separation surgery of conjoined twins, demonstrating exceptional surgical expertise and compassionate post-operative care that resulted in both children thriving independently.

milestone7.title: CAPLAN Prize for Lymphatic Surgery Excellence
milestone7.description: Awarded the prestigious CAPLAN First Prize at the 47th Congress of European Society of Lymphology for groundbreaking work on 'Multilevel Vascularized Lymph Node Transfers', cementing his position as a global leader in lymphatic microsurgery.
